_comment: Your own wording for everything this system sends. Leave a body empty to use the built in writer, which composes each message from the job description instead of a fixed shape. Placeholders in {braces} are filled in per job; an unknown one renders as nothing rather than breaking the send. Every rendered message still passes the style guard, so em dashes and stock phrases are stripped whatever you write here.

application_email._when: Answering a posted role, sent to a person or a careers inbox.
application_email.subject: {role} application, {name}

speculative_email._when: A cold approach to a company with no posted role.
speculative_email.subject: {role} in {location}, {name}

followup_1._when: Six days after the first email, in the same thread.
followup_1.body:
Hello again,

I applied for the {role} role at {company} last week and wanted to put my name back in front of you in case the thread got buried.

If it helps, my work is at {website} and I am happy to walk through anything in the application on a short call.

If the role has been filled or I am not the right fit, please say so and I will stop chasing.

Best regards,
{signature}

followup_2._when: Fourteen days after the first email. The last one, always.
followup_2.body:
Hello,

This is my last note about the {role} role at {company}. I know how full an inbox gets.

If there is still interest I would welcome a conversation. If not, I would be glad to be considered for something later, and I will leave it there.

Best regards,
{signature}

reply_interested._when: They replied and want to talk.

reply_rejection._when: They said no. Short, gracious, never an argument.
